cases.title: Appeal: Impaired driving arrest
cases.text:
Rin Langdale (QB, Renegades) appeals his week 8 ruling: 5 games + $40K for an impaired driving arrest.

THE ORIGINAL CASE: he was stopped at 2:25 a.m. for a broken tail light. A breath test measured his blood alcohol at 0.10 (the legal limit is .08). He was charged with misdemeanor DUI and released the same morning. There was no crash, no injury and no passenger. He has no prior arrests.

HIS GROUNDS: he says he has cooperated with every request from the league, that this is a first offense with a reading near the limit, and that 5 games is out of line with how first offenses at this level have been ruled.

COMPARABLES: in 2044 the desk gave Shaniqua Freeton 5 games + $40K (severity 4.6); in 2043 it gave Annika Schneehagen 2 games + $100K (severity 5.1). This case was rated 4.4.

WHAT YOU ARE DECIDING: uphold 5 games, cut it by 1 game, or lift the suspension and leave the $40K fine.
